name: Gun Bros
long_description: Gun Bros is a top-down twin-stick shooter developed by Glu Mobile. Play as Percy or Francis Gun and fight endless waves of enemies using a wide variety of weapons and gear. The game combines fast-paced shooting with character and equipment upgrades
requirements:
- Install kubridge and FdFix by copying kubridge.skprx and fd_fix.skprx to your taiHEN plugins folder.
- Install libshacccg.suprx to ur0:/data/ or ur0:/data/external/. If you do not have it, follow a libshacccg extraction guide.
- The game runs correctly at the default 444 MHz CPU clock. For the best performance, however, it's recommended to install PSVshell and overclock the Vita to 500 MHz.
